newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Everbright Holdings sets US$150 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: China Everbright Holdings sets US$150 mln FRN.

text.p: China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd's US$150 million floating rate note issue has been launched into general syndication, bankers said on Friday.
The facility has a final maturity of five years with a put option in year three.
The issue was priced at par to float at 60 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate, bankers said.
Fees are 25 basis points for co-lead managers committing US$10 million, 20 basis points for senior managers committing US$7-9 million, and 15 basis points committing US$5-6 million.
Arrangers are Development Bank of Singapore, Oversea Chinese Banking Corp, United Overseas Bank, Overseas Union Bank and Keppel Bank.
Syndication will be closed on June 11.
The China Everbright group has three Hong Kong-listed arms -- China Everbright Technology Ltd, China Everbright International Ltd and China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd.
